notes.title: Matchmaking and balance updates [0.83.24]
notes.notes: [p][b]Adjustments & Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved matchmaking balance for new/low-ranked players. Early battles are more forgiving, tougher ships begin to appears as you delve deeper into your run.[/p][/*][*][p]Matchmaking opponents now have the same amount of wins/losses as you.[/p][/*][*][p]The DPS list now shows both damage dealt and damage taken in separate lists[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to filter by player to DPS list [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Balance Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Mortar Master has new starting layout [/p][/*][*][p]Split/Bounce projectiles now retain 75% damage (was 50%)[/p][/*][*][p]Hull percentage gain is now additive (was multiplicative)[/p][/*][*][p]Rust Mutant no converts hull into armor. 5% → 6% hull conversion.[/p][/*][*][p]Titan Core hull gain: 5% → 7%[/p][/*][*][p]Hull Support Beam hull gain: 5% → 6%[/p][/*][*][p]Mercenary now grants 1 stack of Bio-Rounds[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the Transporter Pad crew member summon turns 2 → 3. Cost 7 → 5[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed rating changes not applying correctly to run history in Endless mode[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Balance and bug-fix patch

notes.title: Down with the Ship to be published by Proxy Studios
notes.notes: [p]Proxy Studios is teaming up with a new solo indie dev—Nate (Iron Anchor Games)—to publish Down with the Ship, a Backpack Battles-inspired spaceship auto battler.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3523750/Down_with_the_Ship/"][/dynamiclink][i]"Design a heavily-armed spaceship. Draft 200+ items, outfit your hull, and unleash it in async PvP. Blend captains and factions for absurd combos and galactic domination. Roll, buy, place, pray."[/i][/p][p]If the game interests you, please consider [u][b]wishlisting[/b][/u], it greatly helps us get the Steam algorithm to show us across the platform.[/p][p]For those who'd like to play it early, we have the first Steam demo ready to go public on Thursday, August 7th, as part of the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/423471/sale/tinyteams2025"]Tiny Teams 2025[/url] and [url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44730990/sale/debutfestival2025"]Debut Festival 2025[/url] festivals (links live once the festivals start on August 7th). [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3668060/Down_with_the_Ship_Demo/?curator_clanid=32939990"][/dynamiclink]We've loved collaborating with Nate so far—he's brilliant and we think he's created a gem of a game. Looking forward to hearing your thoughts as well.[/p]
